OCR request returning multiple pages of document content

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"document\":{\"type\":\"document_url\",\"url\":\"https://example.com/multipage.pdf\"},\"model\":\"mistral/mistral-ocr-latest\"}", OcrRequest::class.java)
    val apiKey = requireNotNull(System.getenv("API_KEY")) { "API_KEY must be set" }
    val result = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey = apiKey).use { client -> client.ocr(req) }
    println(result.pages)
    println(result.pages.first().index)
    println(result.pages.get(1).index)
}
```
